brand.name: Transmogrifier
brand.descriptor: A little app maker for everyday life.
brand.campaign: Make it. Use it. Move on.
brand.lifecycle: Your apps stay until you delete them.

proposedSurfaces.emptyBody: Start with something small. A scorekeeper, a packing list, a lunch picker.
proposedSurfaces.changeLabel: What would you like to change?
proposedSurfaces.setupDisclosure: This early version uses Claude to make apps. You'll need a Claude API key, and Claude charges your account for creating and changing apps. A Claude subscription doesn't include this API usage.
proposedSurfaces.fixDisclosure: Sends error details and relevant app context to your AI service. Usage charges apply.
proposedSurfaces.deleteBody: This removes the app, its files, and its conversation from this device. This can't be undone.

exampleRequests: A scorekeeper for two teams, with big plus and minus buttons.
A packing checklist for a weekend away. Let me add and check off items.
A lunch picker. I'll enter the choices, and it picks one at random.
A counter for laps, with a big button and a reset button.
